blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative three times the quantity x plus four.
Distribute the negative three to both terms, sign included. Negative three times x, plus negative three times four.
Negative three times x is negative three x. Negative three times four is negative twelve, so we subtract twelve.
So the answer is negative three x minus twelve.
Watch out for these traps. If you lose the sign on the twelve, you get negative three x plus twelve. If you multiply only the x, you get negative three x plus four.
